desc:
Enjoy the classic taste of fruit salad‑flavoured chewy sweets, packed with a deliciously fruity chew in every bite. Each pack contains individually wrapped chews, made without artificial colours. Offering a fun, flavourful sweet that everyone can enjoy.

Chewits · Sticks · Fruity
ingredients:
Fruit Salad Flavoured Chewy Sweets

Ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, fruit juice from concentrate (orange, raspberry, pineapple), vegetable fats (palm, coconut), acid (lactic acid), flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein, colour (carotenes).
